# function: get_or_default

Reads a dotenv file and returns the value of a single entry by its key, or `default` if the key does not exist. The file itself must exist.

All supported formats can be found [here](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/germanbrew/dotenv/latest/docs#supported-formats).

Variable references (`$VAR`, `${VAR}`) that are not defined in the file are resolved from the environment of the Terraform process. Use the `dotenv` data source with `expand_env = false` if you need results that do not depend on that environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
output "log_level" {
  value = provider::dotenv::get_or_default("LOG_LEVEL", "info")
}

output "port" {
  value = provider::dotenv::get_or_default("PORT", "8080", "${path.module}/app.env")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
get_or_default(key string, default string, filename string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `key` (String) Name of the key
1. `default` (String) Value returned if the key does not exist
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `filename` (Variadic, String) `Default: .env` Path to the dotenv file. Relative paths are resolved against the directory Terraform is run in, not the module directory. Use `${path.module}` to reference files next to the module, e.g. `"${path.module}/.env"`. This argument is optional.
